name: Microplastic Training Set, 1cm cm^-1 grid (Lei et al. 2022)
description: 3,720 augmented Raman spectra of 14 plastic types (of 4,520 deposited rows -- the 800 synthetically generated blank spectra are excluded) from 186 unique measurements (108 supplier samples) of commercial microplastic particles (spheres, pellets, fragments, films; 15 suppliers) on a Renishaw inVia Reflex (532 nm / 2,400 l/mm or 633 nm / 1,800 l/mm grating). The authors applied polynomial baseline subtraction and cosmic-ray removal, then a 20x augmentation protocol per source spectrum (random noise targeting an SNR of 3-15 on the strongest peak, amplitude normalization so the maximum falls in 0.3-1.0). Spectra span the 720-1,800 cm^-1 fingerprint window, pre-interpolated onto a uniform 1cm cm^-1 grid (1081 points). The four sibling keys microplastics_training_1cm/2cm/4cm/8cm hold the identical spectra at four resolutions -- a built-in instrument-resolution-shift test (the paper trains at 1 cm^-1 and evaluates at 2/4/8 cm^-1). group_ids = supplier sample id: all 20-40 augmented variants of one measurement share a group, and the 108 groups are label-pure.

rai:dataBiases: Data were acquired under controlled laboratory conditions and may not generalise to field or clinical settings. rai:dataLimitations: Reference spectra represent ideal laboratory conditions; real-world samples may show additional interference from impurities, fluorescence, or surface effects.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Facilitates non-destructive material characterisation and identification with applications in geology, environmental science, art conservation, and industrial quality assurance.
rai:dataUseCases: Spectral library matching, material identification, disease screening, compound recognition, quality control.
